transcript.text: I met my rosy-cheeked sweetheart on Songkran Day all smiling At the end of the festival, in front of the stage you were dancing
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ソンクラーンの日に笑顔でバラ色の頬をした愛しい君に出会った お祭りの終わり、ステージの前で君は踊っていたね
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I met my rosy-cheeked sweetheart on Songkran Day all smiling At the end of the festival , in front of the stage you were dancing

translations.ja: ソンクラーンの日に笑顔でバラ色の頬をした愛しい君に出会った お祭りの終わり、ステージの前で君は踊っていたね
translations.en: I met my rosy-cheeked sweetheart on Songkran Day all smiling At the end of the festival, in front of the stage you were dancing
translations.ko: 송크란 날 미소 짓는 발그레한 뺨의 연인을 만났지 축제가 끝날 무렵, 무대 앞에서 당신은 춤을 추고 있었어
translations.zh-TW: 我在潑水節那天遇見了我滿臉通紅的甜心，笑意盈盈 慶典結束時，你就在舞台前跳著舞
translations.id: Aku bertemu kekasih berpipa rona merah di Hari Songkran sambil tersenyum Di akhir festival, di depan panggung kau sedang menari
translations.pt: Conheci meu amor de bochechas rosadas no Dia de Songkran, toda sorridente. No fim do festival, em frente ao palco, você estava dançando

transcript.text: You teased me, saying you loved me with all your heart You snuggled into my shoulder, saying our hearts would never part
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 君は僕をからかって、心から愛していると言ったね 僕の肩に寄り添い、二人の心は離れないと言ってくれた
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You teased me , saying you loved me with all your heart You snuggled into my shoulder , saying our hearts would never part

translations.ja: 君は僕をからかって、心から愛していると言ったね 僕の肩に寄り添い、二人の心は離れないと言ってくれた
translations.en: You teased me, saying you loved me with all your heart You snuggled into my shoulder, saying our hearts would never part
translations.ko: 당신은 진심으로 나를 사랑한다고 놀렸지 내 어깨에 기대어 우리 사랑은 영원할 거라고 말했어
translations.zh-TW: 你調侃我，說你全心全意愛著我 你緊緊依偎在我的肩膀上，說我們的心永遠不分離
translations.id: Kau mengggodaku, bilang mencurahkan seluruh hatimu Kau bersandar di bahuku, bilang hati kita takkan terpisah
translations.pt: Você me provocou, dizendo que me amava com todo o seu coração. Você se aconchegou no meu ombro, dizendo que nossos corações nunca se separariam

transcript.text: Two nights later, you went back to work, our love found its doom You said ‘don’t be afraid,’ you’d be back before the flowers bloomed
transcript.pronunciation_kana: その二日後、君は仕事に戻り、僕たちの恋は終わりを迎えた 花が咲く前に戻ってくるから「怖がらなくていいよ」と言ったのに
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Two nights later , you went back to work , our love found its doom You said ‘don’t be afraid ,’ you ’d be back before the flowers bloomed

translations.ja: その二日後、君は仕事に戻り、僕たちの恋は終わりを迎えた 花が咲く前に戻ってくるから「怖がらなくていいよ」と言ったのに
translations.en: Two nights later, you went back to work, our love found its doom You said ‘don’t be afraid,’ you’d be back before the flowers bloomed
translations.ko: 이틀 밤 뒤, 당신은 일하러 돌아갔고 우리의 사랑은 끝을 맞이했지 '두려워하지 마' 꽃이 피기 전에 돌아올 거라고 했잖아
translations.zh-TW: 兩天後，你回去工作了，我們的愛情迎來了終點 你說「別害怕」，在百花盛開之前你會回來
translations.id: Dua malam kemudian, kau kembali bekerja, cinta kita menemui ajalnya Kau bilang 'jangan takut,' kau akan kembali sebelum bunga-bunga mekar
translations.pt: Duas noites depois, você voltou ao trabalho, e nosso amor encontrou seu fim. Você disse "não tenha medo", que voltaria antes que as flores desabrochassem

transcript.text: I waited, I was sad, holding your picture in tears You must have forgotten our three-month promise that you’d return here
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 僕は待ち続けた、悲しみながら、君の写真を持ったまま涙を流して ここに戻るという三ヶ月の約束を君は忘れてしまったに違いない
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I waited , I was sad , holding your picture in tears You must have forgotten our three-month promise that you ’d return here

translations.ja: 僕は待ち続けた、悲しみながら、君の写真を持ったまま涙を流して ここに戻るという三ヶ月の約束を君は忘れてしまったに違いない
translations.en: I waited, I was sad, holding your picture in tears You must have forgotten our three-month promise that you’d return here
translations.ko: 나는 눈물 흘리며 당신의 사진을 안고 슬픔 속에 기다렸어 여기에 돌아오겠다는 그 3개월의 약속을 당신은 잊었나 봐
translations.zh-TW: 我等待著，我傷心著，淚流滿面地拿著你的照片 你一定忘記了你承諾三個月後會回到這裡的約定
translations.id: Aku menunggu, aku bersedih, memegang fotomu sambil menangis Kau pasti lupa janji tiga bulan kita bahwa kau akan kembali ke sini
translations.pt: Eu esperei, fiquei triste, segurando sua foto em prantos. Você deve ter esquecido nossa promessa de três meses de que voltaria para cá

transcript.text: I can only think of you and wait for the day I can hold you near
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 君のことを思うことしかできなくて、再び抱きしめ合える日を待ち続けている
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I can only think of you and wait for the day I can hold you near

translations.ja: 君のことを思うことしかできなくて、再び抱きしめ合える日を待ち続けている
translations.en: I can only think of you and wait for the day I can hold you near
translations.ko: 나는 당신을 그리워하며 당신을 품에 안을 날만을 기다릴 뿐이야
translations.zh-TW: 我只能思念著你，等待著能再次將你擁入懷中的那一天
translations.id: Aku hanya bisa memikirkanmu dan menunggu hari di mana aku bisa memelukmu erat
translations.pt: Só consigo pensar em você e esperar pelo dia em que poderei abraçá-lo de novo

transcript.text: I keep daydreaming about the words of love I used to hear I don’t know if it was a joke or you really meant it
transcript.pronunciation_kana: かつて聞いた愛の言葉をずっと夢見ている冗談だったのか、それとも本気だったのか分からない
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I keep daydreaming about the words of love I used to hear I don ’t know if it was a joke or you really meant it

translations.ja: かつて聞いた愛の言葉をずっと夢見ている冗談だったのか、それとも本気だったのか分からない
translations.en: I keep daydreaming about the words of love I used to hear I don’t know if it was a joke or you really meant it
translations.ko: 들었던 사랑의 말을 계속 상상해 봐 그게 농담이었는지 아니면 진심이었는지 모르겠어
translations.zh-TW: 我腦海中不斷浮現過去聽過的那些情話 我不知道那是個玩笑還是你的真心話
translations.id: Aku terus melamunkan kata-kata cinta yang dulu ku dengar Aku tidak tahu apakah itu lelucon atau kau benar-benar serius
translations.pt: Continuo sonhando acordado com as palavras de amor que costumava ouvir. Não sei se era brincadeira ou se você falava sério

transcript.text: I’m afraid that the beautiful girl would lie to me in every bit The Siam tulips have bloomed, and they’ll soon wither
transcript.pronunciation_kana: あの美しい娘が僕に嘘をついていたのではないかと怯えている サイアム・チューリップ（※タイのタイ・パトゥムターニー県などに咲く美しい花）は咲き誇り、そしてすぐに枯れてしまう
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I ’m afraid that the beautiful girl would lie to me in every bit The Siam tulips have bloomed , and they ’ll soon wither

translations.ja: あの美しい娘が僕に嘘をついていたのではないかと怯えている サイアム・チューリップは咲き誇り、そしてすぐに枯れてしまう
translations.en: I’m afraid that the beautiful girl would lie to me in every bit The Siam tulips have bloomed, and they’ll soon wither
translations.ko: 그 어여쁜 소녀가 내게 매 순간 거짓말을 했을까 봐 두려워 시암 튜립이 피어났고, 곧 시들어 버릴 거야
translations.zh-TW: 我害怕那個美麗的女孩對我說的每一句都是謊言 暹羅鬱金香已經盛開，不久後也將凋謝
translations.id: Aku takut gadis cantik itu akan membohongiku dalam segala hal Bunga tulip Siam telah mekar, dan sebentar lagi akan layu
translations.pt: Tenho medo de que a linda garota tenha mentido para mim em cada detalhe. As tulipas do Sião desabrocharam e logo vão murchar

transcript.text: I’m still waiting for you, but it seems like you’re gone forever I can’t sleep, I think of you till daybreak
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 僕はまだ君を待っているけれど、君は永遠に去ってしまったように思える 眠ることもできず、夜明けまで君のことを考えている
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I ’m still waiting for you , but it seems like you ’re gone forever I can ’t sleep , I think of you till daybreak

translations.ja: 僕はまだ君を待っているけれど、君は永遠に去ってしまったように思える 眠ることもできず、夜明けまで君のことを考えている
translations.en: I’m still waiting for you, but it seems like you’re gone forever I can’t sleep, I think of you till daybreak
translations.ko: 난 여전히 너를 기다리고 있지만, 넌 영원히 떠난 것 같아 잠을 이루지 못하고, 동이 틀 때까지 너를 생각해
translations.zh-TW: 我依然在等著你，但你似乎已經一去不返 我失眠了，想你想到了天亮
translations.id: Aku masih menunggumu, tapi sepertinya kau telah pergi selamanya Aku tidak bisa tidur, aku memikirkanmu sampai fajar
translations.pt: Ainda estou esperando por você, mas parece que você se foi para sempre. Não consigo dormir, penso em você até o amanhecer

transcript.text: I’m afraid our love will break You’ll forget everything about us The Siam tulips have bloomed, where do you go after the dry season?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 僕たちの愛が壊れてしまうのではないかと怖い 君は僕たちのことすべてを忘れてしまうだろう サイアム・チューリップが咲いた、乾季が終わったらどこに行ってしまうの？
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I ’m afraid our love will break You ’ll forget everything about us The Siam tulips have bloomed , where do you go after the dry season ?

translations.ja: 僕たちの愛が壊れてしまうのではないかと怖い 君は僕たちのことすべてを忘れてしまうだろう サイアム・チューリップが咲いた、乾季が終わったらどこに行ってしまうの？
translations.en: I’m afraid our love will break You’ll forget everything about us The Siam tulips have bloomed, where do you go after the dry season?
translations.ko: 우리의 사랑이 깨질까 봐 두려워 너는 우리에 관한 모든 걸 잊어버리겠지 시암 튜립이 피었는데, 건기가 지나면 어디로 가는 거야?
translations.zh-TW: 我害怕我們的愛會破碎 你會忘記我們之間的一切 暹羅鬱金香開了，乾季過後你去了哪裡？
translations.id: Aku takut cinta kita akan hancur Kau akan melupakan segalanya tentang kita Bunga tulip Siam telah mekar, kemana kau pergi setelah musim kemarau?
translations.pt: Tenho medo de que nosso amor se acabe, de que você esqueça tudo sobre nós. As tulipas do Sião desabrocharam, para onde você vai depois da estação seca?

transcript.text: You don’t have much long before the rainy season My tears are flowing My heart weeps, it’ll soon be winter, don’t keep me waiting
transcript.pronunciation_kana: 雨季までもうあまり時間がない 涙があふれ出る 僕の心は泣いている、もうすぐ冬が来るのに、僕を待たせないで
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You don ’t have much long before the rainy season My tears are flowing My heart weeps , it ’ll soon be winter , don ’t keep me waiting

translations.en: You don’t have much long before the rainy season My tears are flowing My heart weeps, it’ll soon be winter, don’t keep me waiting
translations.ko: 우기까지 얼마 남지 않았어 내 눈물이 흐르고 내 마음은 울부짖어, 곧 겨울이 올 텐데, 날 기다리게 하지마
translations.zh-TW: 雨季來臨前你已經時日無多 我的淚水不斷流淌 我的心在哭泣，冬天快到了，別讓我一直等下去
translations.id: Waktu tidak banyak tersisa sebelum musim hujan Air mataku mengalir Hatiku menangis, sebentar lagi musim dingin, jangan membuatku menunggu
translations.pt: Falta pouco para a estação das chuvas, minhas lágrimas estão rolando. Meu coração chora, logo será inverno, não me faça esperar

transcript.pronunciation_kana: 今や僕のサイアム・チューリップは枯れ果て そして君は二度と戻ってこない
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Now my Siam tulips wither And you return to me never

translations.zh-TW: 如今我的暹羅鬱金香枯萎了 而你再也沒有回到我身邊
translations.id: Kini bunga tulip Siam-ku layu Dan kau takkan pernah kembali padaku
translations.pt: Agora minhas tulipas do Sião murcham E você nunca mais volta para mim

translations.zh-TW: 雨季來臨前你已經時日無多 我的淚水不斷流淌 我的心在哭泣，冬天快到了，別讓我一直等下去
translations.id: Waktu tidak banyak tersisa sebelum musim hujan Air mataku mengalir Hatiku menangis, sebentar lagi musim dingin, jangan membuatku menunggu
translations.pt: Falta pouco para a estação das chuvas, minhas lágrimas estão rolando. Meu coração chora, logo será inverno, não me faça esperar

transcript.text: Now my Siam tulips wither

translations.zh-TW: 如今我的暹羅鬱金香枯萎了

translations.pt: Agora minhas tulipas do Sião murcham

transcript.text: And you return to me never

translations.ja: そして君は二度と戻ってこない

translations.zh-TW: 而你再也沒有回到我身邊
translations.id: Dan kau takkan pernah kembali padaku
translations.pt: E você nunca mais volta para mim
